Track BDC performance through mid-September: private credit flows, bank competition, tighter lending, deal terms, and default trends.

Summary We take a look at the action in business development companies through the third week of September and highlight some of the key themes we are watching. BDCs were flat on the week, enough to outperform most other income sectors. Private credit supply is pressured by negative flows, bank competition, and elevated redemption requests, tightening lending discipline and improving deal terms. Default rates for private loans rose to 6.3%, but software sector defaults declined to 0.6%, reflecting sectoral resilience amid refinancing challenges. Looking for a helping hand in the market?
